page_title: HAV 1-0 BRE | Le Havre v Brest 29/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' The main referee, Benoit Millot, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Kenny Lala (Brest) is given a yellow card for dissent.
90+3' Le Havre take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+2' An accurate cross picks out Mama Balde (Brest) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
86' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Benoit Millot no option but to blow his whistle.
85' Bradley Locko (Brest) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
83' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) is substituted due to injury. Didier Digard gives a chance to Etienne Youte Kinkoue.
80' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
79' Mama Balde (Brest) sends a cross into the box, but Mory Diaw comes off his line to gather the ball.
77' Benoit Millot shows a yellow card to Ayumu Seko (Le Havre) for a tough tackle.
76' The ball rebounds to Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) and he shoots from distance, but the keeper calmly watches it drift high over the bar.
74' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Daouda Guindo walks off the pitch to be replaced by Bradley Locko (Brest).
74' Eric Roy prepares a substitution. Lucas Tousart is replaced by Pathe Mboup (Brest).

73' 1 - 0 A perfectly taken corner kick. Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes in off the inside of the left post, increasing the score of today's match – 1:0.
73' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
72' Didier Digard has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) replacing Simon Ebonog.
72' Substitution. Fode Doucoure walks off the pitch and Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) comes on as a substitute.
72' Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
68' Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
67' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
67' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Now Brest have a corner.
65' Didier Digard has decided to substitute Stephan Zagadou and he is replaced by Loic Nego (Le Havre).
65' That's the end of the game for Thomas Delaine, who is replaced by Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre).
63' Stephan Zagadou (Le Havre) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
63' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots goalwards, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Radoslaw Majecki. What a save!
61' The foul by Joris Chotard (Brest) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Benoit Millot.
61' Benoit Millot interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Joris Chotard (Brest).
61' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Mama Balde (Brest).
57' We are about to witness a subsitution. Mama Balde (Brest) for Junior Dina Ebimbe.
56' The ball sits up nicely on the edge of the box for Godson Kyeremeh (Le Havre), but his powerful first-time shot flies well wide of the right post.
55' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
54' Stephan Zagadou (Le Havre) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
53' Simon Ebonog (Le Havre) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Benoit Millot blows his whistle for a foul.
51' Le Havre seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
48' Simon Ebonog (Le Havre) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
46' What an opportunity! Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) disappointed the fans as he smashed a first-time shot from inside the box against the left post!
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Benoit Millot has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Good movement by Godson Kyeremeh (Le Havre), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
45' Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
43' Benoit Millot shows a yellow card to Daouda Guindo (Brest), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
41' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Le Havre players look gutted.
41' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Le Havre players aren’t happy.
39' Simon Ebonog (Le Havre) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike, which goes inside the left post.
39' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
36' Foul! Simon Ebonog (Le Havre) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
33' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Issa Soumare (Le Havre), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
28' It looks like Soumaila Coulibaly (Brest) saw red with that tackle. Benoit Millot won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
27' How did he miss! The cross loops over the keeper leaving Issa Soumare (Le Havre) with an empty net, but somehow he heads the ball well wide of the right post from close range.
26' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) decides to take on the shot from mid-range after a rebound, but he fails to connect properly with the ball and the effort sails harmlessly wide of the left post.
23' Joris Chotard (Brest) serves up a nice cross, but Mory Diaw punches the ball away.
21' Lucas Tousart (Brest) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the bottom right corner, but Mory Diaw was alert and made an astonishing save!
16' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
15' Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
15' Benoit Millot has a clear sight and sees a foul from Lucas Tousart (Brest).
13' Half-chance! Junior Dina Ebimbe (Brest) plays a pass into the box, but Mory Diaw reacts well to snuff out the attack.
12' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Brest) connects with a cross and has an effort on goal from the edge of the box, but it ends somewhere in row Z.
10' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) is penalised for a foul. Benoit Millot had a clear view and blows his whistle.
8' Ayumu Seko (Le Havre) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Radoslaw Majecki sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the right post.

4' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) wins some space for himself around the penalty spot and manages to produce a promising header. One of the defenders stops his effort before it gets to the goalkeeper, making him redundant.
2' Thomas Delaine (Le Havre) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Le Havre will have the kick-off.
Benoit Millot is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
